snippet.title: Omen Fall Has Been Reforged
snippet.description:
The first major update for Omen Fall is here – the Aytol (Act 1) chapter is now playable!

So, what’s new?

* All artwork has been completely redesigned.
* Core gameplay mechanics have been improved for smoother action.
* Level design has been fully revamped.
* Abilities have been reworked.
* The story and dialogues have been rewritten.
* The soundtrack has been updated.
* Environmental design has been enhanced.
* Controller support has been added.
* Menus and UI have been completely redesigned.
* In-game menus are now available.
* Steam achievements have been added.
* A map system is now integrated.
* Enemy behavior has been made more consistent.
* Boss fights have been fully redesigned.
* Screen resolution options have been added.
* The reward and penalty system has been overhauled.
* Sound and visual effects have been updated.
* New NPCs have been added.
